name: covey-mobile
description: The covey React Native client (issue #168). Its own toolchain, outside the repository's pnpm workspace.
//expo.install.exclude: Packages this project pins on purpose, so `expo-doctor` stops reporting them as out of date. Every one is held back by the repository's 7-day dependency rule (minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml): Expo publishes a patch and pnpm will not resolve it until it has been public for a week, which is the policy working rather than a version to chase. `typescript` is different — it tracks the checkout above, whose packages emit the declarations this app type-checks against, so Expo's preferred major is not ours to take. Removing a name here does not upgrade anything; it only makes the doctor complain again.
